entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The jackal-headed Amonkheti god of zeal, fervor and enduring hope, the only god of Amonkhet to survive the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane of Hazoret and the Amonkheti.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city where Hazoret presided over the final trial and later led survivors to reclaim.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who corrupted Amonkhet and conquered it with Bontu's help.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The ruinous event during which Bolas's arrival destroyed Amonkhet's pantheon except Hazoret.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god who admitted helping Bolas conquer Amonkhet and was betrayed and killed by him.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: A god severely wounding Hazoret before being finished off by Samut and the others.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A character whose spark ignited out of joy at Hazoret's thanks and who later hides with Hazoret's survivors.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Hazoret told he was a better person than he thought.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who grasped Hazoret's spear and transported it to Ravnica.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker who used the spear with Karn against Bolas's Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who used the spear in the climactic battle with Bolas.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Hazoret's loyal lieutenant who led elite fighters against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: One of the insect gods that engaged the Phyrexians at Naktamun.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: One of the insect gods that engaged the Phyrexians at Naktamun.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The title of Bolas's false divine figure in whose embrace initiates were promised the afterlife.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which Hazoret sheltered survivors and lent her spear.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Hazoret defeated Phyrexians at Naktamun.

events.summary: During the Hour of Devastation, Bontu reveals her treachery; Bolas has Bontu bring Hazoret to the God-Pharaoh then kills Bontu, leaving Hazoret the only living god.
events.quote: Hazoret now remains the only living god of Amonkhet.

events.summary: Hazoret fights the Scorpion God and is severely wounded but weakens its armor so Samut and others can kill it.
events.quote: Hazoret managed to weaken its armor enough for Samut and the others to finish it off.

events.summary: Hazoret leads the remaining survivors of Naktamun into the desert, swearing to protect them and becoming the God-Survivor.
events.quote: swearing to protect them as long as she drew breath.

events.summary: Planeswalkers visit Hazoret's camp; she tells Dack Fayden to face his destiny and lends her spear against Bolas, which Karn transports to Ravnica.
events.quote: Hazoret lent her spear as a weapon to take down Bolas

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet uses the spear in the climactic battle with Bolas.
events.quote: Later, the spear was used by Niv-Mizzet in the climactic battle with Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Hazoret and the survivors reclaim Naktamun and begin to rebuild.
events.quote: Hazoret and the other survivors reclaimed Naktamun, raised the Hekma, and began to rebuild.

events.summary: Hazoret ignites the Phyrexians' oil with her spear while the insect gods distract them, and Djeru's fighters dismember them.
events.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins.

events.summary: Hazoret leads survivors through the desert to find Ketramose and Sab-Sunen and helps to manifest them, then searches for more of her kin.
events.quote: Hazoret alone led survivors through the desert to find Ketramose and Sab-Sunen and helped to manifest them.

relations.note: Betrayed and killed her after she delivered Hazoret.
Helped him conquer Amonkhet due to her ambition.
relations.quote: she had helped the dragon planeswalker conquer Amonkhet long ago, due to her ambition
with Djeru as her loyal lieutenant

relations.note: Lent her spear to take down Bolas.
relations.quote: Hazoret lent her spear as a weapon to take down Bolas

relations.note: Samut hid with Hazoret and the survivors.
relations.quote: Samut went into hiding with Hazoret and the survivors of Naktamun

relations.note: She stalks the Locust God and Scarab God, though they fought the Phyrexians alongside her.
relations.quote: stalking the Locust God and the Scarab God and their Chitin Court
